subject: Re: Redwood integration — SDK, auth, rate limits & retries
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Jared Liu <jared.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood integration — post-call recap + next steps

Thanks again for the call today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Integrate Redwood to power multi-turn chat + semantic search for product docs (embeddings + reranker) and add structured tool-calling for order lookups.
- Technical concerns you raised: SDK setup, auth model for service accounts, routing between dev/prod models, structured output/tool calling, and handling rate limits/429s + retries for critical flows.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa (cc) to share a short integration note (SDK snippet, auth patterns, preferred headers for idempotency) — especially around 429 handling and backoff best practices.
2) We’ll share a 1-page MAP and draft timeline by Monday (attaching a draft).
3) Tech sync (30 min) next week to walk the team through embeddings batching and reranker config.

Priya/Jared — can you confirm who on your side will own procurement? Also please share any must-have security controls (SAML, KMS) we should include in the MAP.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-ACME-draft.pdf (1 page draft)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — post-call recap + next steps

Thanks Ben — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: procurement@acme.com is the right inbox; I’ll loop them after we finalize terms.
- Security: we need integration notes for customer-managed KMS and audit logs (SOC2 evidence will be requested later).
- Rate limits: we need resilient retry guidance for our orchestrator (we have several short-lived background workers that fan out requests to the API). Can you confirm recommended backoff & idempotency approach for chat generation (user-facing) vs. background batch embedding jobs?

If Marissa can outline specific headers/SDK patterns we should use, that’ll help us shape the orchestrator.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
priya.shah@acme.com

Thanks Priya — appreciate the quick confirmations.

Action items from us:
- I’ll send an updated MAP by EOD Monday with security controls (KMS, audit logging) as requested.
- Marissa / Rishi will join the tech sync to go through batching and reranker setup — propose Tue 2026-08-24 11:00am PT.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com — please flag any contract constraints (SLA/termination/PII) we should account for.

Priya/Jared — if that time works, I’ll send the calendar invite and include a brief agenda: 1) Embeddings batching & throughput targets, 2) reranker call pattern, 3) production routing + rollout plan, 4) retries / idempotency rules.

Thanks,
Ben
